name: yamlet-pi
description: Spec-driven development with yamlet for the pi coding agent: the yamlet CLI registered as first-class pi tools, with a gate that blocks hand-editing a .yamlet.yaml, .techspec.yaml or .adr.yaml; an interviewing author skill, verifier and tester skills, a tech spec skill that plans the work against your code, and an ADR skill that records each decision as a frozen record; plus the adversarial challengers and the code researcher those flows run as subagents. Requires the `yamlet` CLI on PATH; the agents additionally require @tintinweb/pi-subagents.
